_template_meta.name: role-monitor
_template_meta.description: Permissions scaffold for a 'monitor' role agent — read-only inspection + chat coordination. No file edits, no shell execution beyond pantheon-fetch.
_template_meta._install_note: Replace <path-to-pantheon> with your local pantheon checkout's absolute path before merging into ~/.claude/settings.json. CC permission patterns are matched literally — env-var expansion does not apply.
